slides.title: Why is Moyale's border dispute still unresolved?

slides.text: Al Jazeera reports the Oromia–Somali regional dispute has disrupted **trade, transport and daily life** around **Moyale** since October.
An unnamed security official told Al Jazeera that **mediation failed** and **federal involvement** is needed. Not independently verified.
Al Jazeera notes a **2004 referendum** covered **463 border communities**, but the **Moyale case** was left unresolved.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
